definitions.explanation: Literally a flag raised in rebellion. Almost exclusively used in the fixed expression {反旗|はんき}を{翻|ひるがえ}す (to raise the flag of rebellion), meaning to rebel or revolt against authority.

examples.japanese: {反旗|はんき}を{翻|ひるがえ}す。
{家臣|かしん}が{主君|しゅくん}に{反旗|はんき}を{翻|ひるがえ}した。
examples.english: The retainer revolted against his lord.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}たちが{経営陣|けいえいじん}に{反旗|はんき}を{翻|ひるがえ}し、{改革|かいかく}を{求|もと}めた。
examples.english: The employees revolted against management and demanded reforms.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{反旗|はんき}を{翻|ひるがえ}す (raise the flag of rebellion, revolt)

USAGE NOTES:
Almost always appears in the set expression {反旗|はんき}を{翻|ひるがえ}す. While the literal meaning involves warfare, it is commonly used figuratively for any act of open defiance against authority — a politician breaking from their party, employees challenging management, or anyone publicly opposing the established order.
